elements_selected.content: Write performance and memory benchmark tests for TEST-046 (Merkle construction overhead ≤ 20%), TEST-047 (memory overhead ≤ 30 MB for 10k files), TEST-048 (cache size ≤ 5 MB for 10k files). For TEST-046: generate a synthetic vault with 1,000+ Markdown files (using a loop in the test setup), time zetl index with and without Merkle construction; verify ratio ≤ 1.2. For TEST-047: measure peak RSS before and after Merkle construction on 10k synthetic files; verify delta ≤ 30 MB. For TEST-048: check .zetl/ directory size after indexing 10k files; verify additional size ≤ 5 MB over baseline. Mark perf tests with #[ignore] so they don't run in CI by default (run with cargo test -- --ignored). Document how to run: 'cargo test --features reason -- --ignored perf'. Note: these are smoke tests, not microbenchmarks — sufficient for regression detection.
